title: Negation under the $\pm 1$ embedding
statement:
Let $\mathrm{BoolToPM1} : \mathrm{Bool} \to \bbr$ be the Bool-to-$\pm 1$ embedding, which sends $\mathtt{false}$ to $1$ and $\mathtt{true}$ to $-1$. Then for every Boolean value $b$, negating $b$ flips the sign of its image:
\[
  \mathrm{BoolToPM1}(\lnot b) = -\,\mathrm{BoolToPM1}(b).
\]
hypotheses_covered: b ranges over all Boolean values
